rationale: Builds on the strongest reverse-tail recurrent baseline with one compact structural change: the recurrent tail now keeps the decoder-output anchor early, then gradually refreshes that anchor later in training and at eval. The edit is compile-stable, preserves the existing export/quant-aware path, and targets the still-promising reverse-tail anchor variant category without another tiny scalar sweep.
title: Staged Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Curriculum
